final: WITH t AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), s AS (SELECT link_to_member, total, total * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(total) FROM t) AS share FROM t), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(total) AS combined_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
